items.title: Apple TV is getting video podcasts you can watch for free
items.summary:
Apple's streaming service will soon have a video podcasts section, the New York Times reports. It will start testing the feature in a developer release today, so expect a new update for iOS 27.3 beta testers to roll out in a few hours. Once it rolls out fully, the new video podcasts section will be available to everyone using an Apple TV device or app on all supported platforms.
The expansion follows other streaming services' push into podcasts. Netflix announced it was adding video podcasts to its platform last year, and debuted its first original video podcast series in January. Hulu and Disney Plus also offer podcasts, including a mi …

items.title: America’s air traffic control system couldn’t handle a single bad router
items.summary:
Flight statuses change from delayed to canceled at the San Diego International Airport after the FAA issued an emergency nationwide ground stop on November 13th, 2026. | Photo: Luke Johnson / The San Diego Union-Tribune via Getty Images	

Thirty minutes outside Atlanta, the pilot got on the intercom to announce that something was wrong.
A communications issue with the Federal Aviation Administration was cascading across the country. The pilot didn't offer much detail except to say that the issue might affect gate access and connecting flights.
For Amanda Khera, the timing couldn't be worse. Her family vacation to a small island off the coast of Belize had already turned into a medical scare when her 22-month-old son Rio developed a high fever and had to be rushed to a local clinic. items.title: Audible is trying to make it easier to find audiobooks you’ll actually like
items.summary:
Here’s what the new audio discovery feature looks like in the Audible app. | Image: Audible	

Audible is introducing an AI-assisted synopsis feature that's designed to help users determine whether they'll enjoy an audiobook before they jump in and start listening to it. The new audio discovery feature combines audiobook samples, AI overviews, and author commentary to give users more information before choosing their next story, in addition to recommended audiobook collections that are personalized to individual listening tastes.

items.title: Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you
items.summary:
Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days.
As an example, Google says you can use Ask Maps to plan a day trip for holiday shopping, or have it create a schedule for a three-day road trip with stops for coastal hikes and oceanfront dining. From there, Ask Maps will generate a day-by-day schedule with a list of stops, while also showing your route and numbered pins for each  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

items.title: The Nvidia scandal isn’t slowing down
items.summary:
For years, Jensen Huang has had an almost unprecedented power to shape AI's advancement as Nvidia's CEO, cofounder, and president. As The Verge wrote last week, Nvidia's chips are "the bedrock upon which advanced AI technology in the US is being built." Ever-increasing demand has consistently outpaced supply, leading AI CEOs to essentially bow at Huang's feet as they vie for more compute ahead of their much-hyped IPOs. Nvidia also has a varied investment portfolio of up-and-coming AI companies from neoclouds to infrastructure firms, worth nearly $100 billion, and Huang has President Donald Trump's ear. items.title: Amazon’s Zoox robotaxis are now available via Uber
items.summary:
Uber may be breaking up with Waymo, but it's also gaining a new robotaxi BFF: Amazon. Starting today, Uber riders in Las Vegas can be matched with Amazon-owned Zoox's purpose-built, bidirectional robotaxis.
It's a first for both companies: the first time Uber is adding a purpose-built, steering-wheel-free autonomous vehicle to its network, and the first time that Zoox is opening up its fleet to a third-party app. Uber says that anyone ordering an UberX, Uber Comfort, Uber Electric, Uber Comfort Electric, or Wait & Save in Sin City can get matched with a Zoox at no extra charge. items.title: Senator slams Commerce Secretary for flow of Nvidia AI chips to China
items.summary:
Washington Senator Maria Cantwell, one of the top Democrats on the Senate commerce committee, has taken fire at the Department of Commerce (DOC) under Secretary Howard Lutnick for neglecting to enforce protections intended to keep Nvidia's AI chips away from China. In a letter to Lutnick on Sunday, Cantwell said the DOC has "undermined America's national security," and that its failures "help give away America's technology advantage in AI."

Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
items.summary:
Apple announced a new study today with the goal of better understanding how people interact with conversational AI health tools and how useful their responses actually are. The company is conducting the Apple Health AI Usage Study in collaboration with OpenEvidence, a clinical AI platform used by healthcare professionals that generates answers based on medical information from sources like The New England Journal of Medicine. Participants will use a new iOS app to ask medical questions and then rate the responses based on criteria including accuracy, detail, and relevance.

items.title: Vulcan rocket fails, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites
items.summary:
ULA Vulcan rocket lifts off on November 15, 2026, carrying 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites. | Photo: Manuel Mazzanti / NurPhoto via Getty Images	

United Launch Alliance (ULA) suffered what is reportedly its first mission failure in its 20-year history, failing to deliver 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit. Leo is Amazon's competitor to SpaceX's Starlink, but it has struggled to get off the ground so far, putting only a small portion of the necessary satellites to challenge Starlink into orbit. Today's launch was supposed to be the first of 38 flights Amazon purchased from ULA.
